attchmntText: Mirza International Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Mirza International Limited published newspaper advertisements regarding its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. Standalone total income from operations was 15,795.99 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with a net loss after tax of 438.73 lakhs. Consolidated total income from operations was 16,572.59 lakhs for the quarter, with a net loss after tax of 589.44 lakhs. ZF Commercial Vehicle Control Systems India Limited reported Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 119,053.95 lakhs for the quarter, with a net profit after tax of 12,388.91 lakhs. Gokak Textiles Limited filed Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Total income from operations was 2,617.79 lakhs for the quarter, with a net profit after tax of 251.19 lakhs.

attchmntText: Mirza International Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Mirza International Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results include Standalone and Consolidated figures along with the Auditors' Limited Review Report. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the Standalone revenue from operations was Rs. 28054.07 lakh, with a loss before tax of Rs. 773.45 lakh. The Consolidated revenue from operations stood at Rs. 29304.80 lakh, showing a loss before tax of Rs. 879.83 lakh. The Statutory Auditors expressed an unmodified report on these results. The company noted that tax of Rs. 3.32 crore was accounted for regarding undisclosed income declared in a block return filed on July 24, 2026. Proceedings for the block assessment remain pending.
